name: FMLA Eligibility and Designation Notice
description: Notice whether leave will be FMLA-protected; if eligible, the employee's rights and responsibilities, leave counted, and fitness-for-duty requirement; if not, the reason.
deadline: Within 5 business days of the employee's request
quote: The District shall notify the employee within five (5) business days of the employee’s request as to whether or not the leave will be protected under the FMLA.
